info.name: CAM Intelligence Platform — Full Suite + Mock Server
info.description:
Complete API collection for CAM Intelligence Platform.

Includes:
- Platform APIs (Dashboard, Cases, Companies, Config, LLM, Engines, Agents)
- Smart Onboarding (PAN/GST/Name auto-fetch)
- 360° Company View
- Document Management
- External Systems Mock APIs (MCA, GSTIN, Bureau, Rating, Market, CRILC, EPFO, ITR)

Mock Server: Import this collection and create a Postman Mock Server to simulate all external system APIs for integration testing.
